## Checklist

- [ ] Started from `templates/skill/`; folder name, `SKILL.md` name and `recipe.json` name match
- [ ] `kind` is right: `recipe` (two or more products, with `references/seams-guide.md`) or `skill`
- [ ] It builds on the core skills by name and does not copy their content
- [ ] No secrets, tenant identifiers, customer names or real sample data; placeholders only
- [ ] `npm run validate` passes locally
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] I ran this on a real tenant with the `cli_version` stated in `recipe.json`
